caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest or cabinet, shown at a slight angle so both the front and the right side are visible. The cabinet is colored in shades of brown, with the wood grain and carved details carefully illustrated. The front of the chest features three rectangular panels on the top section, each decorated with ornate carvings of symmetrical, stylized plant or tree motifs; the central panel has the carved letters "MM" beneath a carved arch or garland. Below the panels are two horizontal drawers, each with a round knob at the center and covered in swirling, decorative carvings that match the style of the upper section. The sides of the cabinet are plainer, composed of recessed wooden panels. The cabinet stands on four straight legs, with the same brown wood texture throughout. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, with a few faint marks and alignment lines visible near the edges.
title: Hadley Chest
